_comment: Set-code mapping between phase-rs (the repo's set code: sets/<CODE>/, `--set <code>`, analysis/models/<CODE>.json) and each external source. Read by scripts/deps.py, scripts/build-17lands-ratings.py, analysis/draft_eval/config.py and scripts/export-mtgdt-primers.ts. Edit this file, never the scripts, when a code differs. See docs/UPGRADING.md.

17lands._rule: The 17Lands code is the phase-rs code upper-cased unless `codes` says otherwise. Formats are tried in `formats` order: PremierDraft, then TradDraft only when a set has no PremierDraft file at all.

SPM.reason: Arena released Marvel's Spider-Man as Through the Omenpaths (17Lands code OM1) with different card names, and 17Lands has only PickTwoDraft data for it. Ratings can't be matched to the phase-rs card names, so SPM has no human stats.

notes.KHM: 17Lands has game data only (no draft data file), in the older format without main_colors: card win rates only (no ATA/ALSA, archetype ratings, deck norms or expert pick model).
notes.KTK: The 17Lands data is from the 2024 Arena release of Khans of Tarkir. Card names match the phase-rs KTK booster; Arena collation differs.
notes.AFR: Older file format (January 2024 re-export): draft skill buckets are match-based, so no expert pick model.
notes.MID: Data from 2021, re-exported by 17Lands in January 2024 (older format: no expert pick model).
notes.STX: Older file format without main_colors and with match-based draft skill buckets: card win rates and ATA only.
notes.VOW: Data from 2021, re-exported by 17Lands in January 2024 (older format: no expert pick model).

only_on_17lands._comment: Codes with public 17Lands files but no phase-rs booster data (Arena-only products). `deps check` knows them so it doesn't report them as new sets.
only_on_17lands.HBG: Alchemy Horizons: Baldur's Gate (Arena-only; the paper CLB booster is a different card pool).
only_on_17lands.OM1: Through the Omenpaths (Arena version of SPM with different card names; PickTwoDraft only).

not_used._comment: Kinds of 17Lands files we deliberately don't use.
not_used.alchemy: Alchemy Y-sets (Y22SNC, Y24…): digital-only rebalanced cards with no phase-rs booster data; none had public files when probed on 2026-10-21.
not_used.other_formats: QuickDraft, PickTwoDraft, Sealed and Cube files are ignored (bot or two-pick drafts; different pick behavior).

mtgdecktools._rule: MTG Deck Tools set-context file names (Magic-Deck-Builder src/setContexts/<NAME>.ts) are the phase-rs code upper-cased unless `codes` maps them.
